messages:
rita (sales): New deal - govt customer wants an air-gapped eval. Questions: offline activation tied to HW serial, ability to rollforward (apply deltas) vs rollback, and whether we can deliver OCI images for local registry. Also needs cost for 4-week eval + conversion terms.

noah (solutions): We can provide a self-contained tarball + optional OCI tarballs for import into a private registry. Deltas are supported as signed binary patches with a manifest that includes base_bundle_id and sequence.

mei (eng): Important: delta chain must be applied sequentially. We verify base checksum before applying; if mismatch we abort and recommend full bundle. We also produce a rollback snapshot for safety. Rollforward without missing sequence not possible.

sana (security): Offline activation: we issue a signed license.token JSON containing hw_serial or machine_uuid, entitlements, and expiry. It is signed with our private key; installer verifies with embedded public cert. For higher assurance we offer an HSM-backed signing workflow and an audit attestation file that they can store.

rita (sales): They asked about transfer options - USB, SFTP push, or courier?

noah (solutions): Any secure transfer is fine. We recommend SFTP to their bastion or encrypted USB. For courier must follow export control procedures. We will provide checksums and a detached signature (.sig) for every artifact.

tom (cs): Pricing: example 4-week eval fee $20k (includes packaging & 6 support hours). Conversion: if they sign reserved nodes within 90 days we credit the eval fee pro rata. Managed-update add-on available if they want us to perform updates via bastion for a recurring fee.

mei (eng): For OCI images we produce image tarballs plus signed image-manifest.json. We include an `oci-import.sh` that performs import into registry offline. Note: large model files may make OCI approach bulky; models are usually separate qpack files.

sana (security): Compliance flags: FIPS builds require different binaries and add 2-3 weeks to lead time. Export control: certain model weights may need review. Also they want an offline attestation report after install - we can generate one if they run our attestation binary and share output.

rita (sales): Action items: 1) Draft eval quote + conversion credit terms (tom) 2) Sample license.token and verification steps (sana) 3) OCI + tarball packaging checklist and preflight script (mei/noah) 1d turnaround requested.

infra-bot: Created ticket AGP-9077 "airgap eval: license + delta chain" assigned to mei/noah/tom due 2026-04-18.

rita (sales): I'll request their hardware inventory and preferred transfer method. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
